name: eevee-light-shader-output-regressions
purpose: Verify Eevee Light Shader Output regression coverage for time-dependent uniform results, cache invalidation, and saved-file reload behavior.
passCriteria: The test must render a Light datablock node tree using Scene Time through Light Shader Output, prove frame 1 and frame 11 produce different blue-to-red direct lighting, save and reopen the generated blend file, and prove the reloaded file still renders the custom red Light Shader Output result.
